admission.justification: The four exact pin declarations must agree or provisioning and plugin typechecking can select different host releases. The native manifest independently declares the supported minimum.

applicability: The packaged build selecting Paseo 0.16.2: release-owned host contract, reproducible host package tree and lock, plugin SDK dependency and host requirement.
conditions: The build selects the exact 0.16.2 host release; package declarations and the npm-written lock agree.
The plugin SDK pins the host release. The native plugin manifest states the minimum supported host as Paseo >=0.15.0.
exclusions: An already running older host remains observable until explicit provision; this statement claims no developer-installation upgrade.
The product Node release remains independently pinned, and the plugin's minimum range proves no compatibility with later releases.

evidence: R8 closeout, new freeze (base 120fc025b740e57522d1c1189cdd63524f6543f0, tree 64e80014cd836e724fec2d9bd845b3454ec46a51, change 66521585be77e1b61d5ab5ddf4c76b83462009c860823778853d3b977fbb9adb; ONE comment sentence in client/bridge.ts:273, no behavior). F04 three lines added as record (each unchanged; bridge lines own-read, release anchors from architect check). F02 seen-not-asserted; F06 not met (pin lands without). Review complete, no sixth round (architect own check, D208).

statement: The bundled Paseo host contract, host manifest and complete npm lock pin @getpaseo/cli to 0.16.2. The plugin development SDK pins the same release and the plugin manifest requires Paseo >=0.15.0.
